chunks: They are the people of the right hand
ai.seo_question: Who are the People of the Right Hand in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Aṣḥāb al-Maymanah' is often contrasted with 'Aṣḥāb al-Mash'amah' (People of the Left Hand), emphasizing the spiritual merit of the righteous who are granted ease in reckoning. This designation highlights the divine favor bestowed upon those whose deeds are recorded with honor, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt and the purity of the faithful. The term serves as a key eschatological marker for success in the Hereafter, rooted in the Quranic promise of reward for the virtuous.
